pages.title: Sign in and session recovery
routes: Any protected route when signed out
pages.purpose: Authenticate an assigned user and restore their authorized plant session.
workflow: Open the application address. Enter the assigned email in USER ID and the account password. Select Secure sign in.
On a temporary session loading failure, use Retry session. Sign out clears the local session. A rejected credential returns a generic failure message.

fields.label: USER ID
fields.validation: Browser email format; account must exist and be active.
fields.behavior: Submitted as email to the authentication service.

fields.label: PASSWORD
fields.validation: Required; the server checks the password hash.
fields.behavior: Masked entry. Do not use the demonstration credentials for a real site.

actions.label: Secure sign in
actions.preconditions: Email and password entered; no request pending.
actions.result: Loads the authenticated session or displays an error.

actions.label: Retry session
actions.request: Session validation or refresh as required.

actions.label: Sign out
actions.result: Clears authentication and protected draft ownership.

logic: The initial page is not a separate registration page. New accounts are provisioned by administrators.
Session startup requests have a bounded deadline. An unavailable service is distinguished from invalid credentials.
setup: Create the first administrator with the bootstrap command before attempting the first sign in.

pages.title: Application header and navigation
pages.purpose: Select operating scope, navigate authorized modules, change display currency and read notifications.
access: Signed-in users; the server limits the available organization, plant, unit and asset records.
workflow: Open the plant selector and expand Organization, Plant, Unit and Asset as needed.
Choose the intended plant before changing any records. Expand a sidebar group and open the relevant module.
Use the currency toggle to choose the server-supplied USD or IRR values. Open notifications to follow due work.

fields.label: Organization
fields.requirement: Select the company containing the plant
fields.default: Saved selection or available session scope
fields.validation: Only organizations containing a selectable plant are listed.
fields.behavior: Expands to plants; selecting the organization alone does not select a specific plant.

fields.label: Plant
fields.default: Saved authorized plant or default authorized plant
fields.validation: Authorization is checked on the server.
fields.behavior: Sets the acting tenant and clears stale scoped data when authority changes.

fields.label: Unit
fields.requirement: Optional global selection; required by unit-specific forms
fields.validation: The directory is read in that plant.
fields.behavior: Loaded when the plant node is expanded; selecting a unit includes its parent plant.

fields.label: Asset
options: Active assets in the selected unit
fields.validation: Only active assets are requested by the header directory.
fields.behavior: Loaded when the unit is expanded; header breadcrumb displays the unit path.

fields.label: Display currency
fields.default: USD unless this user previously selected IRR in this browser
fields.validation: Only USD and IRR are accepted.
fields.behavior: Chooses already calculated server values; does not convert money or change rates.

fields.label: Live update status
fields.behavior: Indicates real-time connection state; hidden at narrow widths.

fields.label: User and role
fields.validation: Effective capabilities also include scoped roles.
fields.behavior: Read-only badge appears when every effective role in the selected plant is read only.

fields.label: Notification title body and created time
fields.validation: Current user and acting plant only.
fields.behavior: Unread count is refreshed by real-time hints; opening an unread entry marks it read and follows its link.

actions.label: Expand or Collapse sidebar
actions.result: Switches between full menu and icon rail.

actions.label: Mark all read
actions.result: Marks the current user's notifications read.

actions.label: Open notification
actions.result: Marks unread notification read, closes panel and opens its destination when provided.

actions.label: Sign out
actions.result: Ends the session and clears owned protected drafts.

logic: Navigation visibility follows effective capabilities and feature flags. Hidden navigation is not the authorization boundary; the server checks each request.
Directory lists use pages of 500 and continue through every cursor. Units and assets load on expansion. Directory cache freshness is ten minutes.
Notifications are in-app; this interface does not send email or SMS.
setup: Provision roles and scopes before expecting a user to see a plant or menu item.

pages.title: Unknown address
pages.purpose: Explain that an address is not a registered page and provide a route back.
workflow: Check the displayed path. Select Go to the dashboard to return.

fields.label: Requested path
fields.behavior: Shows the path that was not matched.

actions.label: Go to the dashboard
actions.result: Navigates to /dashboard; authentication is required there.

pages.title: Development UI kit playground
pages.purpose: Preview shared formatting and data states during development. This route is omitted from production builds.
access: Development build and authenticated route only.
workflow: Open the development route. Compare duration, plant time, quantity and data-state examples. Enter a decimal to inspect its formatting.

fields.label: Decimal
fields.behavior: Changes local sample state only; no business record is saved.

fields.label: Scope duration plant time quantity and state examples
fields.default: Sample instant 2026-10-09T02:30:00Z; duration 5400 seconds; loading, empty, no-permission, source-offline, incomplete, calculation-pending and error states.
fields.behavior: Shows shared component rendering; retry is a no-op sample.

logic: Production bundles do not register or import this developer playground.
